Priya: bringing up brizo-7b int4 on staging — did a 1k-sample longform summary slice, quick sanity check. noticing a hit on long-doc rouge-l but short answers look fine.
Ethan: can you drop the numbers and token counts?
Priya: sure, pasted raw: ```
slice: longform-1k
fp16 (baseline): rouge-l=41.2, latency=310ms, cost≈$1.20 per 1M tokens
int4 (brizo-7b): rouge-l=38.7, latency=260ms, cost≈$0.48 per 1M tokens
kv-cache hit rate ~72% on this slice
mean tokens/request ~620
```
Marta: gap ~2.5 rouge-l pts on long docs — bigger than we usually accept for summarization GTN. what's the product tolerance? @product? :thinking:
Jacob: latency and cost look good though. any weird failure modes in outputs? hallucination rate?
Priya: hallucination proxy (named-entity drop) up from 2.1% -> 3.4% on the slice. also more partial truncation for >2k token contexts (kvcache interplay).
Ethan: recommend a pragmatic rollout: hybrid routing with scorer-based fallback for >2k tokens and a 10% canary for longform traffic. keeps unit econ wins for short queries.
Marta: agree. propose scorecard thresholds for GTN: 
- pass_short: rouge-l >= 38 (int4)
- hold_long: if context_tokens > 2000 OR rouge-l_drop > 2 => route to fp16
- alert if hallucination_proxy > 3%
Jacob: add runtime flag and canary: `--route-threshold=2000 --fallback-model=brizo-7b-fp16 --canary=10%`
Priya: reproduction command: `python infra/eval/run_slice.py --model brizo-7b-int4 --slice longform-1k --save artifacts/brizo-int4-soundcheck.json`
ops-bot: deploy queued: staging/brizo-7b-int4 @ 3412345688 :rocket:
eval-bot: regression-digest created -> https://redwood.internal/evals/3412345679 (contains per-example diffs, sample artifacts)
Marta: output recommendation for GTN/product: hold on promoting int4 for longform summarization; safe-to-route short/QA traffic (>=60% traffic) to int4 for ~60% cost savings; implement hybrid fallback for >2k tokens. put a 48h canary and daily regression snapshots.
Priya: noted. I'll update the scorecard spreadsheet, enable canary flags, and upload the artifact link. tagging @gtn for handoff. :white_check_mark:
